articles.note: Mexico treaty exempts foreign-source remittances only. No US-source wage exemption.

notes: AUDIT 2025-05-19: Verified Article 21 (foreign-source remittances only) against IRS Pub 901 Table 2 (Mexico) and US-Mexico Income Tax Convention (1992) Article 21. Despite Mexico being a top source country, the treaty has NO US-source student wage exemption — common point of confusion.
